idle.prompt: Create canonical 8-direction IDLE game sprites of ONLY Sherininya, the white-haired hooded ADULT mage on RIGHT in reference1. Match corresponding guide body AND head angle, never substitute straight back for back diagonal. Match locked design exactly: huge chibi head/short body same as mannequin, ivory-white chin-length bob with long bangs covering her own LEFT eye (viewer RIGHT in S), sleepy HALF-LIDDED cool gray-teal eyes, pale vermilion upper-eye makeup and soft dusty mauve cute UNDER-EYE CIRCLES, tiny indifferent mouth and lowered shoulders; languid, never wide-eyed or smiling alert. Black high collar capelet and cape with gold trim/buckle, rich teal lining at back/inside, short black gold-trim tunic dress, loose pale white-gray puff sleeves, black gloves, black knee-high laced boots and small upper-thigh gap. Warm hand-painted storybook game art matching approved design, face readable at96px sprite height. Each character fits entirely inside its own equal cell with generous completely TRANSPARENT gutters. No ground shadows or colored haze, no particles, no captions, no grid. TRUE transparent background. All full boots present. Prioritize EXACT sleepy expression, mauve eye circles, vermilion makeup, white bob, black/teal hood, fuller silhouette.
